name: docx-package-redline-and-render-verification
intent: Edit a word-processing package while preserving structure, relationships, review semantics, and visually verified pagination.
successCondition: Stop when package integrity, relationship safety, tracked changes, and rendered pages all pass review.
operations: inspect package parts relationships and external targets
validate XML relationships comments and change markup
render pages and compare layout pagination and visual defects
preconditions: external relationships and embedded content are inventoried
positiveTriggers: Apply a controlled redline to an authorized DOCX package.
Verify package relationships comments tracked changes and rendered pages.
negativeTriggers: Open or preserve unknown external links without inspection.
Accept a text-only diff as proof of document layout.
failureModes: stop when package relationships escape the approved scope
reject edits that corrupt tracked-change or rendering semantics
exclusions: does not follow external package links
does not claim legal adequacy of a redline
terminationConditions: Stop when package integrity, relationship safety, tracked changes, and rendered pages all pass review.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-logos route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
